english.title: Assault prisoner custody officer acting in pursuance of escort arrangement whilst in possession of imitation firearm
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), assaulted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a prisoner custody officer acting in pursuance of prisoner escort arrangements and was, at the time of

(A)_[committing]_
(B)_[being arrested for]_

the assault, in possession of a firearm, namely **(..SPECIFY FIREARM..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 90(1)(a) and 90(2) of the Criminal Justice Act 1991 and sections 17(2) and 51 of, and Schedules 1 and 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
assault prisoner custody officer acting in pursuance of escort arrangement
whilst in possession of imitation firearm

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: It is a defence to show that possession of the firearm is for a lawful purpose - section 17(2) Firearms Act 1968

other.penalty:
Indictment: Life imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for Prosecution;
None
